title: Integration receipt (proposal 0013)
description: Written by the emitting side of a registered integration (registry/integrations.json) for every exchange, locally first. One object per line in key order as listed here, no insignificant whitespace, UTF-8, LF between lines. receipt hash = SHA-256 over the line's bytes without the LF. The witness (NFL) commits that hash with artifact label 'constellation.integration.receipt.v1:<consumer>><provider>'. No timestamps: the witness records when it saw the hash.

contract.description: Which of the integration's contracts this exchange used; null only when the registry record lists no contracts.

request_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact bytes sent; null when nothing was sent.

response_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact bytes received; null when nothing came back.

carried.description: Hashes of documents the exchange already produced that record it themselves (the record's receipt.carries), for example an Arbiter policy.decision.v1.

outcome.description: ok, or the explicit state the local contract gives a missing or failing counterpart (integration rule 7).

error_token.description: Named error token; null exactly when outcome is ok.

prev_sha256.description: Hash of this emitter's previous receipt for the same integration; 64 zeros for the first.
